# observation

The read-only HTTP boundary for a viewer of one Loom server. The query filters authorized observations before constructing a response. An absent query result still produces a snapshot.

`loom.observation` is one of loom's bounded contexts. [All domains](./index.mdx).

## Commands

### `ReadSnapshot`

`loom.observation.ReadSnapshot`.

It takes:

- `agent` — `Optional<String>`, which may be absent
- `from` — `Optional<Timestamp>`, which may be absent
- `to` — `Optional<Timestamp>`, which may be absent

It has seven outcomes.

**`denied`** — Decided outside the input: The request did not authenticate a viewer.. No predicate over the input reaches this branch, and saying `when: false` instead would have claimed it is unreachable, which is a different and false statement. No entity in this specification changes. It reports `loom.observation.ViewerRequired`. It emits nothing. A test reaches it by injecting the declared fault, because no input can.

**`invalid`** — Decided outside the input: The query is malformed or the time interval is empty or inverted.. No predicate over the input reaches this branch, and saying `when: false` instead would have claimed it is unreachable, which is a different and false statement. No entity in this specification changes. It reports `loom.observation.InvalidQuery`. It emits nothing. A test reaches it by injecting the declared fault, because no input can.

**`unavailable-viewers`** — Decided outside the input: The private viewer configuration cannot be read.. No predicate over the input reaches this branch, and saying `when: false` instead would have claimed it is unreachable, which is a different and false statement. No entity in this specification changes. It reports `loom.observation.NoViewerConfig`. It emits nothing. A test reaches it by injecting the declared fault, because no input can.

**`unavailable-snapshot`** — Decided outside the input: A registered observation cannot be read.. No predicate over the input reaches this branch, and saying `when: false` instead would have claimed it is unreachable, which is a different and false statement. No entity in this specification changes. It reports `loom.observation.NoSnapshot`. It emits nothing. A test reaches it by injecting the declared fault, because no input can.

**`forbidden`** — Decided outside the input: The authenticated viewer has no agent grants.. No predicate over the input reaches this branch, and saying `when: false` instead would have claimed it is unreachable, which is a different and false statement. No entity in this specification changes. It reports `loom.observation.Forbidden`. It emits nothing. A test reaches it by injecting the declared fault, because no input can.

**`not-found`** — Decided outside the input: The selected agent does not exist in the viewer's scope.. No predicate over the input reaches this branch, and saying `when: false` instead would have claimed it is unreachable, which is a different and false statement. No entity in this specification changes. It reports `loom.observation.UnknownAgent`. It emits nothing. A test reaches it by injecting the declared fault, because no input can.

**`observed`** — The default branch, taken when no other outcome's condition matched. No entity in this specification changes. It emits nothing. A test reaches it by constructing an input that satisfies no other outcome's condition.

## Errors

### `Forbidden`

It carries nothing beyond its name, so a caller can tell what went wrong and not which value caused it.

Reported by `loom.observation.ReadSnapshot` on its `forbidden` outcome.

### `InvalidQuery`

It carries nothing beyond its name, so a caller can tell what went wrong and not which value caused it.

Reported by `loom.observation.ReadSnapshot` on its `invalid` outcome.

### `NoSnapshot`

It carries nothing beyond its name, so a caller can tell what went wrong and not which value caused it.

Reported by `loom.observation.ReadSnapshot` on its `unavailable-snapshot` outcome.

### `NoViewerConfig`

It carries nothing beyond its name, so a caller can tell what went wrong and not which value caused it.

Reported by `loom.observation.ReadSnapshot` on its `unavailable-viewers` outcome.

### `UnknownAgent`

It carries nothing beyond its name, so a caller can tell what went wrong and not which value caused it.

Reported by `loom.observation.ReadSnapshot` on its `not-found` outcome.

### `ViewerRequired`

It carries nothing beyond its name, so a caller can tell what went wrong and not which value caused it.

Reported by `loom.observation.ReadSnapshot` on its `denied` outcome.
